'''Comviva''' (formerly known as '''Mahindra Comviva''') is a telecommunications company headquartered in [[Gurgaon]], [[Haryana]], with additional offices in [[Bangalore]] and [[Mumbai]]. It also has offices in Johannesburg, Kenya, Abidjan, Nigeria, [[Dubai]], Indonesia, Australia, Netherlands, the [[United Kingdom]], Colombia, and the [[United States]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Contact Us|url=https://www.comviva.com/corporate/contact-us/|access-date=2021-09-16|website=Comviva|language=en-GB}}</ref>

==History and acquisitions==
Founded in 1999 in New Delhi, Comviva was incorporated as Bharti Telesoft Limited. In April 2009, it was renamed Comviva Technologies Limited.<ref>[http://www.comviva.com/media/BTSL_rebrand_Comviva_ET.pdf "Bharti Telesoft Now Comviva"], ''[[The Economic Times]]'', 17 April 2009.</ref> Comviva merged with CellCloud Technologies Limited, a Bangalore headquartered company, offering "electronic top-up solutions", in December 2002. In December 2007, Comviva acquired Jataayu Software Limited, a Bangalore-based provider of "value added telecom solutions".<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ciol.com/news/news-reports/bharti-telesoft-acquires-jataayu/191207102342/0/ |title=Bharti Telesoft Acquires Jataayu|website=CIOL|date= 19 December 2007 |accessdate=6 August 2009 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110927234413/http://www.ciol.com/news/news-reports/bharti-telesoft-acquires-jataayu/191207102342/0/ |archivedate=27 September 2011 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In September 2012, [[Tech Mahindra]] acquired a 51 percent stake in the Gurgaon-based mobile application firm Comviva from Bharti Group.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20130826121247/http://articles.timesofindia.indiatimes.com/2012-09-18/software-services/33924871_1_tech-mahindra-cp-gurnani-enterprise-mobility "Tech Mahindra buys 51% stake in Comviva"], ''Times of India'', 18 September 2012.</ref> In February 2013, Comviva was re-branded as Mahindra Comviva. In February 2014, it partnered with Bharti Airtel to deploy its enterprise communications platform in 16 countries across Africa.<ref>{{cite web|title=Mahindra Comviva and Bharti Airtel partner in 16 African Countries|url=http://news.biharprabha.com/2014/02/mahindra-comviva-and-bharti-airtel-partner-in-16-african-countries/|work=IANS|publisher= |accessdate=25 February 2014}}</ref>

In January 2016, the company acquired a controlling stake in Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS), a leading provider of mobility solutions{{clarify|date=December 2021}} to the telecom industry in Latin America to strengthen its in-region presence.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-01-23|title=Mahindra Comviva buys majority stake in ATS to up Latin America play|url=https://www.techcircle.in/2016/01/23/mahindra-comviva-buys-majority-stake-in-ats-to-up-latin-america-play|access-date=2021-09-16|website=Techcircle|language=en-US}}</ref> In 2019, Mahindra Comviva was re-branded again as Comviva (a Tech Mahindra company). The company was also rebranded to Comviva in 2019.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Comviva Technologies: Scripting The Next Growth Agenda For The Digital Age|url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/brand-connect/comviva-technologies-scripting-the-next-growth-agenda-for-the-digital-age/56151/1|access-date=2021-09-16|website=Forbes India|language=en}}</ref>

In 2023, Comviva and e& Enterprise announced a partnership to develop an advanced CPaaS ecosystem and leveraging Comviva's CPaaS platform.<ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ETTelecom.com |title=Comviva, e& Enterprise expand partnership to offer CPaaS platform for enterprises - ET Telecom |url=https://telecom.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/enterprise-services/comviva-e-enterprise-expand-partnership-to-offer-cpaas-platform-for-enterprises/101279122 |access-date=2023-09-14 |website=ETTelecom.com |language=en}}</ref>

== Products and Services ==
